records.task: Follow the caval trunk in 3D beside the aorta. The CT label identifies the caval exterior only.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: The protected grazing contour on the caval shoulder is present. Its maximum gap is 1.18 mm after local correction, and all three sweep cuts stay within 1.78 mm.
scoreEvidence.form: The bowed lower trunk is smoother than the previous export. The upper flare has residual horizontal bands near the supported shoulder and the artificial crop cap.
scoreEvidence.readability: The oblique view shows the blue caval trunk beside the aorta. The liver overlaps its upper extent. Orbiting and opening the tissue overlay clarify the relationship.
scoreEvidence.economy: The abdominal port falls from 17,476 to 6,000 triangles. Its worst silhouette departure from the dense shaped surface is 0.91 px at 3 px/mm.

records.disposition: Adopt for the named 3D orientation task
records.note: The CT label supports caval course and exterior orientation. The worked view supplies its own teaching observations about patency and the hepatic confluence.

comparison.label: Previous and refined caval exterior
comparison.candidateLabel: Inspect the lower trunk and the upper shoulder in front, reverse and close views.

views.label: Raw label and both caval exteriors
views.candidateLabel: The raw lower trunk has axial steps. The candidate retains the flare near its superior display limit.

views.label: Source cuts and grazing contour
views.candidateLabel: The small loop is recovered at the +1.5 mm parallel cut. The limits set before shaping still apply.

views.label: The IVC sweep at frame 12
views.candidateLabel: The liver overlaps part of the upper cava. The simulated section and overlay stay registered to the same CT.

links.label: Source, replay and protected contour measurements
